messages:
emily: Heads-up — ran an authz-aware telemetry sampling sim against prod-like traffic and saw a 1m window where debug-level captures bypassed PII redaction. Not loud in prod but reproducible in the sim :thinking:
sam: Ugh. Any idea which path triggered it? route, tenant, or the inspect-canary? :eyes:
emily: Looks like it was a rare routing fallback: requests routed to the legacy mux where the sampler config was stale. The sampler returned `allow` when it should have applied tenant-level redaction.
ops-bot: ALERT: sampling-bypass-detected for tenant=acme-inc at 2026-03-19T14:12:03Z (sim). See /alerts/4860001111
juan: Can you paste the sampler config from the legacy mux? quick grep might show the mismatch. Also check `sampler.mode` vs `route.overrides`.
emily: pasted snippet from the sim here:
```
# legacy mux sampler config (sim)
sampler:
  mode: sticky
  default: sample
  tenant_overrides:
    acme-inc: allow_debug_capture
```
juan: there it is — `allow_debug_capture` slipped into tenant_overrides during a previous test and never cleared. The new router expects `redact_debug` or `inspect_optout`.
katie: For mitigation: propose a small playbook + a console toggle. Short-term: flip tenant flag to `redact_debug` via the ops CLI. Mid-term: add validation in the router control plane to reject unknown override tokens. Also add a dashboard anomaly rule for mismatched sampler vs route policies.
sam: Agreed. Can we also add an emergency route policy that forces `redact_debug` for all legacy mux fallbacks? I don’t want to rely on manual tenant edits during an incident.
juan: Quick option: update `routing.policy.fallback_rules` to include an enforcement rule: `on_fallback -> enforce(redact_debug)` — patchable with a single config push. Example: 
```json
{"routing": {"fallback_rules": [{"match": "legacy_mux", "enforce": "redact_debug"}]}}
```
katie: That works. UX note: console needs a visible banner when the fallback enforcement is active, plus an audit log entry. Otherwise SRE will be confused when captures disappear.
emily: I’ll make the config patch for the sim and validate. Then we should run a 5m canary on staging and push to prod if clean. Sam — can you own the console banner/audit PR?
sam: Yep. I’ll add a tiny UX spec: 1) banner w/ reason, 2) link to runbook, 3) toggle w/ expunge warning.
ops-bot: RUNBOOK STEP: 1) Identify affected tenants: `alerts/4860001111/tenants` 2) Apply fallback enforcement patch 3) Rotate sampler override cache `kubectl rollout restart deployment/legacy-mux` 4) Verify redaction in traces 5) Record audit event
juan: Minor follow-ups: add unit test for parsing unknown tenant override tokens, and add an alert rule for sampler/route divergence (threshold: >0.1% of requests).
katie: Also log a UX telemetry metric: `console.banner_shown` with origin `fallback_enforce` so we can measure confusion reduction.
emily: Timeline: patch sim now, 5m canary in staging in 2h, prod push if green. I’ll open the config PR and reference this thread. Assigning: emily -> config patch, sam -> console PR, juan -> parser test + alert rule, katie -> telemetry metric.
emily: Thanks all. Post mortem follow-ups: ensure sampling config rollout is gated by schema validation in the control plane. :+1:
sam: :thumbsup:
juan: :ok_hand:
ops-bot: NOTE: Incident simulated only — no customer data affected in prod.
